# Copilot instructions

This repository is the Prompt Architect: a compiler that turns a plain-language request into
a purpose-built prompt or an installable skill.

When the user asks for a prompt or a skill to be written, improved, reviewed, or packaged,
read `skills/prompt-architect/SKILL.md` in full and follow its stages rather than writing one
from scratch. Open a file under `skills/prompt-architect/references/` when the stage that
needs it runs, not before, and return the output in the format `SKILL.md` specifies.

When the user is instead changing this repository, read `AGENTS.md` and `CONTRIBUTING.md`
first. `AGENTS.md` covers both cases in more detail.
